Overview.Name: Chandra Ponugupati
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) + thick curd
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + egg curry (2–3 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Paneer (80 g) + vegetable curry (no rice)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + egg curry (2 eggs)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Thick curd bowl + boiled vegetables (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Start every meal with eggs or paneer before eating rice.
Limit rice to controlled portions to improve sugar and lipid levels.
Avoid fried foods, sweets and bakery items completely.
Walk 10–15 minutes after lunch and dinner to improve insulin response.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch for better metabolic control.
With consistency, expect improved blood markers and gradual waist reduction in 8–12 weeks.
